mapper.select: SELECT BASE.YEAR, BASE.pnu FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c_year) AS RNUM, A.c_year AS YEAR, A.pnu FROM kapa_official_price_tmp A) AS BASE WHERE BASE.RNUM BETWEEN (#{_page} * #{_pagesize}) + 1 AND (#{_page} + 1) * #{_pagesize}

SELECT BASE.YEAR, BASE.s_reg AS reg, BASE.standard_seq_no AS num FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c_year) AS RNUM, A.c_year AS YEAR, A.s_reg, A.standard_seq_no FROM kapa_standard_price_tmp A) AS BASE WHERE BASE.RNUM BETWEEN (#{_page} * #{_pagesize}) + 1 AND (#{_page} + 1) * #{_pagesize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kapa_official_price ( c_year, pnu, standard_seq_no, reg, eub, san, bun1, bun2, as1, eub_name, jibun, area, gakuka, gimok, gimok_str, youngdo, youngdo_str, giyuk, giyuk_str, gojeu, gojeu_str, hung, hung_str, ban, ban_str, jub, jub_str, fasc, fasc_str, fascy, tm_x, tm_y, use_yn) SELECT #{cYear}, #{pnu}, #{standardSeqNo}, #{reg}, #{eub}, #{san}, #{bun1}, #{bun2}, #{as1}, #{eubName}, #{jibun}, #{area}, #{gakuka}, #{gimok}, #{gimokStr}, #{youngdo}, #{youngdoStr}, #{giyuk}, #{giyukStr}, #{gojeu}, #{gojeuStr}, #{hung}, #{hungStr}, #{ban}, #{banStr}, #{jub}, #{jubStr}, #{fasc}, #{fascStr}, #{fascy}, #{tmX}, #{tmY}, #{useYn} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM kapa_official_price WHERE c_year = #{cYear} AND pnu = #{pnu} )

INSERT INTO kapa_standard_price(seq_no, c_year, s_pnu, s_reg, s_eub, s_san, s_bun1, s_bun2, eub_name, jibun, gimok1, gimok1_str, gimok2, gimok2_str, giyuk1, giyuk1_str, youngdo1, youngdo1_str, youngdo2, area, gojeu, gojeu_str, hung, hung_str, ban, ban_str, jub, jub_str, fasc, fasc_str, gakukc, gakuk1, gakuk2, gakuk3, gakuk4, tm_x, tm_y, wgs84_x, wgs84_y, use_yn, created_time) SELECT #{seqNo}, #{cYear}, #{sPnu}, #{sReg}, #{sEub}, #{sSan}, #{sBun1}, #{sBun2}, #{eubName}, #{jibun}, #{gimok1}, #{gimok1Str}, #{gimok2}, #{gimok2Str}, #{giyuk1}, #{giyuk1Str}, #{youngdo1}, #{youngdo1Str}, #{youngdo2}, #{area}, #{gojeu}, #{gojeuStr}, #{hung}, #{hungStr}, #{ban}, #{banStr}, #{jub}, #{jubStr}, #{fasc}, #{fascStr}, #{gakukc}, #{gakuk1}, #{gakuk2}, #{gakuk3}, #{gakuk4}, #{tmX}, #{tmY}, #{wgs84X}, #{wgs84Y}, #{useYn}, NOW() FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM kapa_standard_price WHERE c_year = #{cYear} AND s_reg = #{sReg} AND seq_no = #{seqNo} )
